display.title: Episode 369: I Love Hashem (Purim)
display.summary_short: Uncle Yossi's Purim show: a helicopter full of little soldiers, Purim songs with graggers, and Beryl's lesson from a mirror with the song 'I Love Hashem'.
display.summary_long: Broadcast on Purim 5749. Uncle Yossi keeps trying to open the show, but strange noises and laughter interrupt him, until a helicopter lands in Studio 604 and hundreds of little Tzivos Hashem soldiers march out singing, because on Purim it is a mitzvah to be happy. Out come the graggers for a sing-along of Purim songs with a guest singer. Before story time, Uncle Yossi recalls how Mordechai gathered thousands of Jewish children to learn Torah, and a girl from a Brooklyn girls' school leads the Shema. The story: Beryl comes home from school and asks his mother for a large mirror. His Rebbe taught, in the spirit of the Baal Shem Tov, that we can learn from everything we see: show the mirror a happy face and it smiles back, and when we serve Hashem with joy, Hashem shines back on us. We are happy because we have a neshamah, because we have the Torah and mitzvos, and because they bring us close to Hashem. Beryl then teaches the song 'I Love Hashem'. The show ends with the Shiviti Club winner in the newsletter, a listener's letter, and Purim wishes.
display.lesson: Serve Hashem with joy: show a happy face and Hashem shines back on you. Love Hashem, His Torah and every Jew.

date.note: Aired on Purim day (14 Adar II); the show wishes everyone a happy Purim.
